tier2_explanatory.long_meaning: From the Greek petros (πέτρος), 'rock, stone', a translation of the Aramaic Kepha. Its root is Greek petra (πέτρα). Simon Peter, the apostle (Matthew 16:18). Peter is a Greek name meaning “Rock; stone”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
